cues: Look how often the equation lies.
Two N two O five should give a squared term, but the observed law is first order.
Chloroform and chlorine give an order of one and a half.
Only hydrogen and iodine happen to match.
The reason is mechanism: the rate is set by the slowest step, and only species in that step appear in the rate law.
